native_empty_boundary.empty_predicate: Original selected native text has zero codepoints or every codepoint is in the frozen explicit White_Space set, after successful strict decoding and the original length/control checks.
parakeet_additional_proof: Original fixed command, model/runtime identity, environment, complete input, STARTED and RETURNED receipts agree.
Process actually started and returned exit code 0; no timeout, exception or unknown consumption.
Complete native stdout and stderr are preserved without transforms; the exact successful-return evidence is independently reopened.
native_empty_boundary.phone_provider_rule: XLSR/LV60 retain the complete finite nonempty native logits matrix, exact vocabulary, shape, frame coverage and original parser. Empty greedy token sequences are not empty native payloads. Missing, zero-byte, malformed or nonfinite matrices remain fatal.
native_empty_boundary.qwen_additional_proof: Original native envelope is a list of exactly one native result whose text field is a string; preserve the original envelope and its exact UTF-8 text. An empty list, missing field or non-string value is fatal.
native_empty_boundary.whisper_additional_proof: Original native envelope is a dict with a present string text field; preserve the original envelope and its exact UTF-8 text. A missing field, None or non-string value is fatal.

purpose: Present one material prospective SOURCE-policy choice for explicit user decision; do not reinterpret or resume any consumed experiment.

quarantine_rule.unit: One immutable original ID and PCM, not a selected provider response and not an entire person.

return_dispositions.condition: Every one of the five original native payloads is valid; ASR text is nonempty and phone tensors are complete finite nonempty matrices.
return_dispositions.panel_action: Continue the fixed plan; eligibility alone does not assign a class or pass a source minimum.

return_dispositions.condition: At least one ASR return satisfies every exact successful-empty proof requirement, and no fatal condition exists.
return_dispositions.panel_action: Keep the entire original out of all admission and KWS; continue every remaining preplanned call once.

return_dispositions.condition: A nonempty return fails its original parser, envelope, Unicode, shape, identity, hash, coverage or numeric validation.
return_dispositions.panel_action: SOURCE_STOP; no admitted subset can rescue this panel.

return_dispositions.condition: Timeout, exception, nonzero process exit, missing/partial raw data, unknown consumption, model initialization failure, duplicate or unplanned call, or incomplete required ledger.
return_dispositions.panel_action: SOURCE_STOP; no replay, replacement, resume, inference of empty, or KWS opening.

scientific_risks_and_limits.consequence: Quarantining may remove hard positives or alter the negative population; absence of KWS peeking does not make this missingness random.
scientific_risks_and_limits.mitigation: Symmetric whole-original quarantine, fixed preplanned calls and complete stratified attrition reporting make selection visible; they do not remove the bias.
scientific_risks_and_limits.risk: Selection depends on observer success, which can correlate with accent, speaker, duration, rare pronunciation or acoustic difficulty.

scientific_risks_and_limits.consequence: The existing floors sum to 48 qualified originals (12 synthetic positive, 24 synthetic ordinary, 12 natural), so in a compatible panel up to 72 of 120 originals could be excluded while numerical minima still hold. The existing eight paired families/eight natural readers remain additional requirements.
scientific_risks_and_limits.mitigation: Disclose the actual full-denominator coverage. No new attrition threshold, post-result cutoff, or statistical correction is silently introduced.
scientific_risks_and_limits.risk: Fixed source minima are coverage floors, not a bound on all missing data.

scientific_risks_and_limits.consequence: This is an explicitly prospective protocol amendment motivated by failures, not an independent confirmation of the prior whole-panel protocol.
scientific_risks_and_limits.mitigation: Preserve old failures; require explicit approval and a fresh separately frozen primary plus sealed replica; prohibit repeated panel shopping or claims of retroactive success.
scientific_risks_and_limits.risk: A more permissive orchestration rule is chosen after two SOURCE stops.

scientific_risks_and_limits.consequence: Misclassifying missing data, a timeout or corrupt envelope as a successful empty would hide execution failure.
scientific_risks_and_limits.mitigation: Authenticate the complete native return and replay the exact unchanged whitespace-only predicate; all uncertainty remains whole-panel STOP.
scientific_risks_and_limits.risk: Provider evidence can be malformed despite text that looks empty.

scientific_risks_and_limits.consequence: A future numerical PASS is conditional on the fixed five-observer-admissible subset and cannot by itself establish field FRR, FAR/hour, latency or SSC305 deployment readiness.
scientific_risks_and_limits.mitigation: Keep separate sealed replication, engineering, physical and field requirements; do not train on or infer outcomes for quarantined originals.
scientific_risks_and_limits.risk: Surviving source rows are not the deployment population.

single_policy_change.before: Every missing, empty or invalid native payload terminates the entire panel.
single_policy_change.proposed_after: Only a proved successful native empty text return quarantines that whole original; all other malformed, failed, missing or uncertain returns still terminate the panel.

historical_control_provenance.evaluation_forwards: The same four-model quality evaluation, including this fixed control, remains within the unchanged KWS budget.
historical_control_provenance.inherited_quality_criteria_wording: The copied B14 positive criterion contains the historical phrase same-run control. Here that numerical control role maps explicitly to the original B23 model above; no matching rerun or causal-isolation claim is made.
historical_control_provenance.role: Exact immutable original B23 challenger, not a newly trained same-job matched control

quality_criteria.ordinary: No added event on any qualified ordinary original/gain versus B9/control; natural false-event totals at each gain no higher than B0. Improve >=2 natural readers at original gain versus B9.
quality_criteria.positive: Preserve every B0 and same-run control positive original/gain hit; no extra duplicate events versus B9/control. Recover >=1 qualified positive family with B9 hit, control miss and challenger hit.
quality_criteria.reject_if: Any missing source, same-speaker ancestry, failed source minima, lost positive, extra positive event, added ordinary event or B0 natural regression. No threshold or coefficient sweep.

validation_scope.fixtures: Invented standard-library admission-invariant examples only; not a production observer, actual failure authenticator, native forward or model test.
